business_overview.one_sentence: The Group designs, develops, manufactures, installs and sells environmental pollution prevention equipment and electronic products, mainly in Mainland China.

segments.name: Environmental protection equipment and related materials

business_overview.revenue_model: Revenue mainly comes from sales and installation of environmental protection equipment; control is recognised at product delivery, and contract assets/liabilities reflect service and payment timing.
business_notes: The Group has only one business segment according to note 8.
Five largest customers accounted for 89.02% of total revenue in 2025, showing high project/customer concentration.
Products include electrostatic precipitators, bag filter precipitators, and SO2/NOx emission reduction devices.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Interest income on bank balances; excluded from core cash profit when related cash principal is treated as detachable.
Government grants included in other income.
Equity-method loss from associates; not a current operating cash outflow.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated profit or loss, p.89

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Credit impairment losses, including RMB47.386m trade receivable impairment and RMB2.398m contract asset impairment.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated cash flow statement p.93 and notes 21-22 pp.142-146

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash and cash equivalents at year end; RMB-denominated group bank and cash balances including pledged deposits amounted to RMB833.178m and are subject to PRC foreign exchange control.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of financial position p.90, cash flow statement p.94, note 24 p.147

funds_assets.business_substance: Pledged bank deposits securing bills payable; not freely detachable.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position p.90, note 24 p.147, note 25 p.148

operating_assets.business_substance: Raw materials, work in progress and finished goods for environmental protection equipment projects.
Trade receivables and bills receivable after loss allowance; trade receivables include long-aged balances and no collateral.
Right to consideration for transferred products or services.
Includes RMB128.845m prepayments and RMB33.747m other receivables after impairment.
Buildings, plant and machinery and other operating fixed assets.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position p.90 and note 15 p.135

investment_assets.business_substance: Unlisted strategic associates in magnetic materials and wind energy; not treated as detachable cash.
Residential and commercial properties; part pledged for bank loans.

other_assets.business_substance: Deferred tax assets, mainly impairment-related and unrealised profit in inventories.

financing_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position p.90 and note 27 pp.148-149

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Bills payable secured by pledged bank deposits; disclosed under supply chain financing arrangement with effective rate of 18%.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Customer advances or consideration received before product/service transfer; performance obligations outstanding are RMB3.504bn.

other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2025, statement of financial position p.90

years.source: Annual Report 2025 comparative figures, pp.89 and 93-94

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2025 cash flow covered reported profit after capex, but cash conversion quality is constrained by large contract liabilities, a RMB283.933m inventory build, RMB102.954m increase in prepayments/deposits/other receivables, high customer concentration, and RMB49.784m credit/contract asset impairments. Only 2024-2025 cash-flow facts were extracted from the current annual report.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2025, consolidated cash flow statement p.94 and note 24 p.147
Annual Report 2025, note 24 p.147 and note 25 p.148
Annual Report 2025, consolidated cash flow statement p.93

gaps: The annual report does not split bank and cash balances by parent company, operating subsidiaries, deposit tenor, onshore/offshore location beyond RMB denomination, or dividend remittance path.
Only current-period annual report facts were extracted into the fact pack; 2023 operating cash flow and capex were not extracted from a separate 2023 annual report in this run.

Necessary operating cash cannot be precisely disclosed from the annual report and is estimated in the owner earnback analysis using revenue, contract liabilities, inventories and project cash-flow volatility.
